title: Implement consumed-template tracking with shared index pool, atomic generation, and admin reset controls

requirements.summary: Update generateComment and generateBulkComments mutations to handle new response metadata and trigger refetches
acceptanceCriteria: generateComment mutation receives and exposes availableAfter from response
generateBulkComments mutation receives and exposes generatedCount and availableAfter
Both mutations invalidate/refetch getListMetrics and getAvailableCount after success

file_operations.description: Update the generateComment mutation to pass deviceId from localStorage, handle the new response metadata fields (availableBefore, availableAfter, totalTemplates), and invalidate getListMetrics and getAvailableCount queries on success. Update the generateBulkComments mutation to handle the new response metadata fields (generatedCount, availableBefore, availableAfter, totalTemplates) and invalidate the same queries on success. Ensure both mutations expose the metadata to their callers for immediate UI updates.

requirements.summary: Update UserView Single Comment Generator to immediately reflect availableAfter and show out-of-comments badge
acceptanceCriteria: Available Comments count updates immediately after generation using availableAfter from response
Out-of-comments badge appears when no pool entries remain
Lock notice is shown immediately from localStorage claim without extra backend round-trip

file_operations.description: Update the Single Comment Generator section to immediately update the displayed 'Available Comments' count using response.availableAfter after a successful generateComment call. Show the 'Out of comments' badge when the backend returns an out-of-comments error or when availableAfter is 0. Ensure the device lock notice appears immediately using the localStorage claim stored after generation without requiring a separate backend query.

requirements.summary: Update BulkCommentGenerator to show immediate count updates, clamping toast, and out-of-comments state
acceptanceCriteria: Available Templates label updates immediately to availableAfter after successful bulk generation
Toast notification shown when generatedCount < requestedCount
Generate button disabled and 'Out of comments' shown when pool is empty after generation

file_operations.description: Update the component to immediately reflect response.availableAfter in the 'Available Templates' label after successful bulk generation. If the backend clamped the count (generatedCount < requestedCount), display a toast notification: 'Only X available, generated X.' where X equals generatedCount. If availableAfter is 0 after generation, disable the Generate button and show an 'Out of comments' message.

requirements.summary: Add Reset Pool and Reset Pool + Clear Claims controls to Admin Comments with confirmation dialogs
acceptanceCriteria: 'Reset Pool' button appears per list in Admin > Comments
'Reset Pool + Clear Claims' button appears per list in Admin > Comments
A confirmation dialog is shown before either reset action executes
On success, list metrics and available count are refetched
A success toast is shown after reset completes

file_operations.description: Add two reset buttons per comment list in the Manage Comments section: 'Reset Pool' (restores available indices without clearing device claims) and 'Reset Pool + Clear Claims' (restores pool and removes all device claims for that list). Both buttons must trigger a confirmation dialog before calling the resetPool backend mutation with the appropriate clearClaims boolean flag. On success, show a success toast and refetch getListMetrics and getAvailableCount queries to update the UI.

requirements.summary: Add useResetPool mutation hook to call backend resetPool method and invalidate queries
acceptanceCriteria: useResetPool mutation hook calls backend resetPool with listId and clearClaims boolean
On success, getListMetrics and getAvailableCount queries are invalidated/refetched

file_operations.description: Add a useResetPool mutation hook that calls the backend resetPool(listId, clearClaims) method. On successful mutation, invalidate and refetch the getListMetrics and getAvailableCount queries to ensure the UI reflects the restored pool state. This hook will be consumed by the AdminComments view for the reset controls.
